correctness.rationale: Conditional three-way increment law is exact. Reconstructed martingales C/mu and D=B-(1-p)(C-1)/p; checked recurrences for first/second C moments and E[CD], including every normalizing factor. The exact b_(m+1)-b_m formula has denominator m+p and threshold p/m, and strict monotonicity of q_m proves one covariance sign transition. L2 positivity proves V_p>0. Taylor expansion of exact correlation shows coefficient of n^(-p); cross-covariance correction squared is o(n^(-p)). Standalone independent rational enumeration for n<=7 (151086 configurations) and finite parameter/size sign checks replayed, with finite/infinite distinction explicit.

value.rationale: One natural, parameter-free geometrical boundary count and the size of its parent cluster exhibit opposite small-n and large-n covariance signs. The exactly-one-transition proof is a structural theorem, not a numerical cutoff; the explicit n^(-p) rate quantifies when daughter-component fluctuations become almost entirely driven by parent-cluster fluctuations. This dependence is not supplied by either marginal law or by daughter vertex-mass formulas.
